edges.reason: The prescribed-direction planner and Nano protocol share the recovered source candidate's pulse scale, capture hold IDs and HOME exceptions; hardware flash consistency remains a separate acceptance gate.
Preview preserves negative ordinary moves, bounded HOME exceptions and confirmed capture hold semantics from the candidate without representing hardware evidence.
portable:build must compile current assets and publish the verified desktop executable with build metadata.
The portable executable contains the desktop host, frontend assets and verified engine payload.
Tauri embeds current frontend assets and shares its 1920x1080 design baseline; DPI-aware window limits and edge-to-edge client filling must stay aligned.
UI actions and rendering depend on the client hook and complete engine snapshots.

Both adapters implement the snapshot contract, including nullable measured telemetry, on/off/unknown beamState and engine-issued camera property/option support and effective write permissions; failed IPC invalidates displayed readings.
Preview output must stay structurally and semantically compatible with production snapshots.
Tauri invoke command names and payload fields are string-based runtime contracts.
The frame_preview command accepts a committed frame index and returns an embedded JPEG from the engine-registered, hash-verified NEF.

An internal engine-issued user-ACL endpoint carries bounded JPEG envelopes and a version-2 session/sequence delivery acknowledgement; the desktop retries transient instance gaps only within the existing deadline, validates session/sequence/codec/dimensions before acknowledging, and the renderer can supply only afterSeq.
Camera presets import/export through native JSON dialogs; the domain validates the entire schema and active capabilities before persistence or explicit Apply.
The reconstruction_preview command accepts only a method ID and returns an engine-registered, hash-verified preview volume for a completed reconstruction.
JSONL v2 validates request ID/sequence/session and returns complete snapshots plus operation records; Stop/state remain available during background device work and stale generations cannot commit.
Every exposure transaction depends on verified X-ray readback and fail-closed shutdown.
Projection commit requires a confirmed host-side image file.
Motion, warning, emergency stop, and CAPTURE_DONE use the external Nano protocol.
The application supplies angleKnown, signed rotationDirection, task identity and feedback freshness; scene interpolation must never predict device motion or update scan state.
Scene colors and visibility semantics must follow the shared theme and safety state.
Directory selection and log export cross the browser-to-desktop boundary.
Capture-ID-only IPC resolves engine registration, rechecks byte bounds/hash and rejects stale descriptors without renderer paths.
Install/replace requires matching session/operation maintenanceLocked ready report with device cleanup and no transactions before EOF and owned-process exit zero.
Restricted update check/status/cancel/native-import/confirm actions share verified state and never accept renderer endpoints, keys or package paths.
NSIS/MSI/portable assets and offline ZIP share version/target/kind/size/hash and data/global signature validation with a fixed public key.
Platform updater functions bind check/status/cancel/native ZIP import/confirmed apply to restricted desktop IPC; browser preview cannot invoke installation.
